# Chr <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Chr:String ascii:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ascii` | In | Int32 | required | The character code, 0 to 255. |

**Returns:** A string with a single character.

## Description

Returns the one-character string for a character code. [Asc](Asc) does the opposite.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Chr$(72) + Chr$(105)
```

```text
Hi
```
